# Gambler — Artifact Set Reference

- **Max Rarity**: ★★★★

## 2-Piece Bonus
Elemental Skill DMG increased by 20%

## 4-Piece Bonus
Defeating an enemy has 100% chance to remove Elemental Skill CD. Can only occur once every 15s.
